packageRules.description: Ansible (the Runner image's ANSIBLE_VERSION pin): every update automerges, majors included, but only once all the PR's checks pass. The Runner image build and its smoke test (a play with facts, a community.crypto module and YAML output, no warnings allowed) are the stage gate. Renovate merges by itself (platformAutomerge off) because GitHub's auto-merge would wait only for the branch's required checks, not these.

customManagers.description: Pinned tool versions in Dockerfiles: a `# renovate:` comment directly above an ARG (a git-refs comment names the branch; the ARG holds the commit)
